$comment: One published image per entry. The key is the macOS SDK major version and the image tag. sha256 pins the staged tarball (scripts/stage-xcode.sh) that CI downloads from the private apple-sdks bucket. swiftImage is the Linux Swift toolchain: the Swift that shipped with that Xcode, or the oldest later one with Swift Build (Swift 6.1 has none). latest marks the tag also published as :latest.
